0.content:
Amber is Eula's oldest and staunchest friend; they were close long before Eula joined the Knights. On Eula's first day Amber cleaned her dormitory and showed her around headquarters. Since then she has run her errands, made shopkeepers sell to her at normal prices and announced her achievements to the city from a stage of crates. Eula complains that it makes her look like an older sibling who needs the younger one to do everything ("For this, she must pay!"). Amber says Eula is a great friend once you get used to her sense of humour.

Eula trusts Amber completely partly because she was the beloved mentee of Amber's grandfather, the first Outrider. They took part together in the 2.3 Dragonspine winter camp (limited), where Eula promised to back Amber up whenever Bennett's bad luck struck. In the 4.4 limited event Amber, Eula and Mika stopped at a Liyue inn for a proper meal after a long trip on rations.

In Eula's 2025 birthday letter, the Knights forced her to take her accumulated leave and Amber dragged her to Natlan. Amber said she was nervous travelling so far, then enjoyed herself the most, kept "circling above" as a gliding champion and fussed over whether Eula was eating and sleeping well.

1.comment: Eula: Amber's grandfather, the old Outrider
1.content: Before she found her Vision, Eula, struggling with the weight of her bloodline, came under the tutelage of a "long-forgotten old outrider": Amber's grandfather, founder of the Outriders. From him she learned open-mindedness and down-to-earth persistence, and that before grappling with grievances and vengeance she first had to discover herself. When she found a gentle path of revenge that was hers alone, her Cryo Vision appeared.

2.content: The Gunnhildr and Lawrence families are sworn enemies, yet Jean separates personal and professional matters: she saw Eula's ability, admitted her and gave her opportunities. Eula promises her "a reasonably soft landing" when vengeance comes. About once a month Eula marches into Jean's office sword in hand for a "tea break"; Kaeya tells nervous recruits it is ritual sparring, but Lisa hurries over so as not to miss the tea, and there is never any noise. Jean calls the rumours about Eula groundless and says she does not mind Eula's constant talk of challenging her.

3.content:
Grand Master Varka praised Eula as the Dandelion Knight's equal on the battlefield. She finds him a good man who ignores rumours, but their one spar ended in a tie while he looked relaxed and plainly held back: "Such indignity! I will not let it go!" He told her that her record, if not enough to restore the Lawrence name, is a strong rebuttal to one-sided opinions, and she is satisfied with that.

During the Nod-Krai expedition (6.4), Varka's letter promised to test whether her skills had regressed; she asked the Traveler to watch whether he goes all out next time. Varka praises her for arranging the reception of returning troops at Dornman Port perfectly and without once mentioning vengeance. She was among the knights at Windrise when he came home.

key: The Spindrift Shall Never Return to the Sea
4.comment: Eula: Schubert and the Fatui plot
4.content:
In her story quest (1.5), Jean asked the Traveler to approach Schubert Lawrence, Eula's uncle, suspected of dealing with the Fatui. Schubert rebuffed their "vulgar" manners, so Amber sent them to Eula, whom they met in the Stormbearer Mountains when she cut down a Fatui sniper aiming at them. Eula drilled the Traveler in noble speech and "dignified" fighting, then sent them to Schubert with a gift of his favourite dish, Gebratenes Fleisch mit Sauerkraut. Schubert took them to a Fatui hideout and handed over a diagram of the city's northern wall and patrol routes, in exchange for a promise that the Lawrence flag would fly over Knights headquarters.

When Schubert fled, Eula and her knights caught him. He ordered her to attack her fellow knights and rejoin the clan. She told him she had never experienced the "glory" he spoke of, but she could tell right from wrong and understood what freedom means to Mondstadt: the Lawrence Clan "should never and will never become" what he dreamed. She had him taken away, and then told the Traveler, deadpan, that they had stolen her targets again.

5.comment: Eula: The Lawrence Clan and the Glacial Seal
5.content:
The Lawrence Clan led Mondstadt's old aristocracy until Vennessa's revolution about a thousand years ago, and Mondstadt still remembers its slavery and despotism. The surviving family hopes to rule again and trains its children for that day. It calls Eula a traitor for joining the Knights. Eula, the eldest daughter, bears the Glacial Seal, the clan's highest martial symbol, having passed its rarely completed trial while still young. She has barely contacted the clan since.

The Dance of Sacrifice, created long ago by Mondstadt's leading clans, has the Lawrences' solo third act, "Flickering Candlelight", performed by the eldest daughter. Bleeding toes were once a point of pride. It is now just a graceful pastime. Eula still holds it dear, says it puts her mind at ease, and says anyone who wants to learn her Favonius Bladework must pass her dance class first.

6.content: While tracking Abyss Order cargo disguised as ordinary goods for shipping from Dornman Port to Liyue Harbor, Eula's company found Yanfei, a consultant for the merchant vessel who had discovered the cargo and started investigating. A few minutes later and she might have died. With her help Eula captured all the Abyss Order operatives near the port, and the Liyue Communications Office wrote to thank the Knights. They have corresponded ever since. Eula likes that Yanfei knows the rules but bends them sensibly, and hopes she might help track down someone Eula is looking for. Yanfei admires Eula's carefree spirit.

7.comment: Eula: Mika and the Reconnaissance Company
7.content: Eula's Reconnaissance Company patrols Mondstadt's wilds, including an area that borders the sea, and supports her unconditionally. Kaeya introduces her as Captain of the 4th Company. Its designated chef adapted her pie into the company's prized field ration. Mika, a surveyor, was expected to last days but completed every task, then volunteered to run errands and handle communication for her. Eula denies she needs looking after. Mika calls her friendly and free-spirited, with remarkable mental fortitude, and says the extra tasks she assigned him quickly improved his adaptability. He later joined Varka's expedition, and she notes how much he has improved.

8.content: In 5.6 Jean gathered the captains, Eula among them, for a joint trial of Albedo. Eula said Albedo was "an alchemist, not a sadist". She testified that she, the Traveler, Amber and Bennett had been with him on Dragonspine during the Adventurers' Guild event, and when the real Hertha challenged the impostor to name the location of her longest scar, Eula said she remembered it and demanded the answer. The trial was a trap for impostors spawned from Durin's life force, and Eula kept the plan so well hidden that Amber thought it was real. During the monster attack she lost track of Klee for a second, fretted about explaining it to Albedo, and fought alongside him while Klee covered them with bombs. Afterwards she let Klee "escort" her back to headquarters.

9.comment: Eula: Dragonspine winter camp (Shadows Amidst Snowstorms)
9.content: During a limited-time 2.3 event, Eula helped Amber and the Adventurers' Guild run a winter training camp on Dragonspine. The boy Joel, who did not know what the Lawrence name meant, called her "Aunty Eula", and she was quietly glad. She admitted she had never built a snowman because of her strict upbringing; Amber called her first attempt "too artistic". She caught what looked like Albedo leading Joel toward a monster-ridden wasteland, fought it off and confronted Albedo, then agreed to believe an impostor was responsible. She survived an avalanche with the group, endured Bennett's bad luck and gave the Traveler a souvenir at the end.

10.content: In a limited-time 3.8 event, Eula and Collei found a fairground in the Veluriyam Mirage. Earlier on the trip, Eula encouraged Collei by offering to teach her dance. Inside the Mirage they found Eula's cousin Lessig Lawrence. He had travelled to restore the clan's honour, found no one cared about his lineage, lost his wallet and injured himself trying to "fix" the Mirage. He first demanded her help in the name of family dignity, which she scorned. After he apologised, he told her the journey had humbled him and he now wanted a Mondstadt where people did not fear the Lawrences. He realised Eula had understood this before the rest of the clan. She urged him to tell his parents and offered to help persuade them.

11.content: Limited-time appearances, canon but not universally known. Of Drink A-Dreaming (2.5): slightly drunk after The Cat's Tail, she came to the Traveler's bar and admitted she always drinks alone because Mondstadt taverns will not leave a Lawrence in peace, then asked how they make so many friends. Receiver of Friends From Afar (4.4): she treated Amber and Mika to Liyue food at an inn, and the wiki ties Stormcrest Pie to their field rations. Alchemical Ascension (4.5): wiki summaries say she befriended Beidou at Dornman Port. Springtime Charms (5.3): she is among the characters at Liyue's Lantern Rite.

12.comment: Eula: Homeward event: Clorinde, Dragonspine and the drinks stand
12.content: In the limited-time 6.4 Homeward event, Eula, chosen as the Knights' representative, met Clorinde for a swordsmanship exchange; Clorinde was impressed by the Knights' greatsword work. Following a book Mona lent her, she bought rare Romaritime Flower juice at Dornman Port to host Clorinde at a post-duel banquet. At the Traveler's drinks stand she described weeks of fireless stealth near Dragonspine against outlaw engineers controlling Ruin Graders, veteran transfers who resented "that Lawrence girl" until the battle won them over, too-salty new canned rations, and her push to place in the top three captains in the annual combat assessment.

13.comment: Eula: Bone whistle and the Spindrift Knight
13.content: Eula always carries an exquisitely carved bone whistle, a Liyue tradition. She imitates crashing waves with it to confuse enemies along her sea-bordered patrol area and to scare simple monsters into fleeing an imagined tsunami. That habit earned her the name Spindrift Knight; many assume she uses Hydro. Her character story suggests she prefers the free, rolling sea to cold, rigid ice. Mist Flower powder improves the whistle's tone. She has given one as a birthday gift, with lessons, so the recipient can "fend her off" on their day of reckoning.
